definitions.explanation: A person of exceptional courage, ability, or achievement who is admired for their great deeds. Used for historical figures, legendary characters, and modern-day people who accomplish remarkable things.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{国民|こくみん}の{英雄|えいゆう}だ。
{歴史|れきし}に{名|な}を{残|のこ}した{英雄|えいゆう}たちの{物語|ものがたり}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: Read stories of heroes who left their names in history.

examples.japanese: {英雄|えいゆう}{色|いろ}を{好|この}むということわざがあるが、{実際|じっさい}の{英雄|えいゆう}には{質素|しっそ}な{人|ひと}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There is a proverb that says heroes are fond of romance, but in reality, many great figures were frugal people.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{英雄|えいゆう} is a somewhat literary or elevated word for "hero." In everyday conversation, ヒーロー (hero, loanword) is also widely used, especially for fictional or pop-culture heroes. {英雄|えいゆう} tends to suggest a more serious, historically significant figure.

The proverb {英雄|えいゆう}{色|いろ}を{好|この}む (heroes are fond of romance / great men have great appetites for love) is well known in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英雄|えいゆう}{伝説|でんせつ} (hero legend)
- {英雄|えいゆう}{的|てき} (heroic)
- {悲劇|ひげき}の{英雄|えいゆう} (tragic hero)
- {民族|みんぞく}の{英雄|えいゆう} (national hero)
- {英雄|えいゆう}{色|いろ}を{好|この}む (heroes are fond of romance — proverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ヒーロー: hero (loanword, casual, often for fictional heroes)
- {勇者|ゆうしゃ}: brave warrior, hero (common in games and fantasy)
- {豪傑|ごうけつ}: bold hero, mighty warrior (emphasizes physical prowess)
